title: Listening Drill — Introductory animation — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Introductory animation — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on introductory animation last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with jerky motion. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: loose mount.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of frame rate so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow storyboard sheets instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the media tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Tuesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
